1. **Can you get admitted?**
2. **Can you actually succeed in the program and come out employable in technical DS/ML roles?**

Those are not the same thing.

For your profile, I think admission is plausible if you prepare deliberately over the next 6–12 months. The harder issue is whether you can close the quantitative and technical gap quickly enough to avoid struggling badly once enrolled.
